title: New York-based Hatz AI, which makes tools for managed services providers to help small businesses adopt AI, raised a $24M Series A (CJ Fairfield/CRN)
summary: CJ Fairfield / CRN: New York-based Hatz AI, which makes tools for managed services providers to help small businesses adopt AI, raised a $24M Series A — 'Small businesses are trying to figure out how to transform themselves right now into being AI-first or AI-native, and it's a job that's very, very hard to do without help.
